questions.q: Tin is between iron and lead. Predict its reaction with dilute acid.
questions.a: Very slow fizzing (slower than iron, faster than lead)
questions.model: Find its place: below iron, above lead. Iron reacts slowly, lead very slowly. So tin reacts very slowly.

questions.q: Explain why sodium was discovered much later than copper.
questions.a: Sodium is very reactive, always in compounds, and needed electricity to extract
